{{Quote|The Tuskens are sneaky. They're living in that junk town just outside the city. I'm going to have you go out there and do some recon.|Purvis Arrison|<ref name="SWG:TRiME" />}}
'''Junktown''', more informally known as the '''junk town''', and later as the '''Tusken Village''', was a small [[City/Legends|village]] just outside of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was originally a place for [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealers]] to conduct business, before it was taken over by the planet's native [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]]. [[Bantha Moving and Storage]], a front company for a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] organization, used this location to hide their activities. Sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a young smuggler sent by [[Radeld Siwar]] traveled to the junk town and stole spice samples and recipes from the company's hiding places.

==Description==
[[File:Junktown.jpg|250px|thumb|The Tusken junk town with Mos Eisley in the background]]
Junktown was a [[City/Legends|village]] located on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], a sparsely populated [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Located on the eastern outskirts of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], Junktown was something of a shantytown constructed out of a variety of crude dwellings, including [[Tent/Legends|tents]] and [[Sandstone/Legends|sandstone]] structures. Junktown also comprised of at least one [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]], several harvesting machines, and a [[salon]]. A towering [[Color/Legends|grey]] stone like structure also protruded from the settlement.<ref name="SWG:TRiME" />

==History==
{{Quote|There's a company called Bantha Moving and Storage. Ever heard of em?''"<br />"''Um...no.''"<br />"''They're new to the smuggling game. They're using that Tusken village to hide their activities, keeping their computers there and sneaking around when the Tuskens are busy.|Radeld Siwar and a smuggler|<ref name="SWG:BMaS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Smuggler|Bantha Moving and Storage|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
Junktown, also known simply as the junk town, was a small settlement located near Mos Eisley. It was a haven for the various [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealers]] who sold refurbished goods to the locals. Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Junktown was overrun by a group of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]],<ref name="TCSWE" /> and thereafter also became known as the Tusken Village.<ref name="SWG:BMaS" />

Around this [[Time/Legends|time]], a former military [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] named [[Purvis Arrison]] launched a personal war against the Tuskens in Junktown.<ref name="SWG:TRiME" /> A [[Unidentified genetically altered Twi'lek|genetically altered Twi'lek]] working for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] helped Arrison by conducting recon in Junktown and wiping out a sizeable portion of Tusken's population.<ref name="UiME">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?page=Undercover%20in%20Mos%20Eisley&resource=features|text=Undercover in Mos Eisley}}</ref>

After arriving to Mos Eisley, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] referred an aspiring [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] to a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] named [[Radeld Siwar]] to learns the ropes of the smuggling trade. To that end, Radeld put the [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to work investigating the nearby Junktown, which he suspected was being used by a smuggling company called [[Bantha Moving and Storage]] to hide their activities.<ref name="SWG:BMaS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Junktown was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TRiME" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
